Bovo.description: Whenever you command an allied minion to make a weapon attack and the attack hits, it can then follow up with a second weapon attack that has disadvantage.
Whenever you use your Commanding Presence to command an ally, the ally can also shift up to 5' as part of the same reaction
You count as being 3 levels higher for the purposes of scaling your Commanding Presence's area

Viktor.description: Your Monstrous Minion's Shocking Coils graft now triggers whenever your Monstrous Minion is hit by any weapon attack. Additionally, Shocking Coils deals +1 damage.
The new attack granted by your Monstrous Minion's Grafted Weapon graft now grants the weapon has +1 to attack rolls
Whenever you take a short rest, your Monstrous Minion recovers all lost HP so long as you tend to it with your tools of artifice.
Viktor.upgrade: the first time your Monstrous Minion gains temporary HP after a short rest, it gains 9 more/1

Junie.description: Whenever you grant a Bardic Inspiration die to a creature, you can also grant one to another ally within range at the same time.
Junie.upgrade: +10% for the extra die to not cost one of your dice/1

Junie.description: You gain 1 additional use of Bardic Inspiration.
